posted_text:
🗳️ NJ A5641 — NJ Limits Military & Law Enforcement Near Polling Places

New Jersey is now restricting the presence of active duty military and certain law enforcement officers within 100 feet of polling places and ballot drop boxes during elections.

This new rule extends existing protections to federal law enforcement and members of the New Jersey National Guard, specifically allowing for their deployment by the Governor to ensure voter access if needed.

The Attorney General can bring civil action to enforce these restrictions.

Oct. 22, 2026: Reported and Referred to Assembly State and Local Government Committee.

🔗 Read the full bill: https://www.njleg.state.nj.us/bill-search/2026/A5641
